sources.entry: Blave Agent - Desktop workspace where your own Claude Code or Codex writes trading strategies, backtests them and runs them live on crypto exchanges.

summary.one_liner: Blave Agent is a free, open-source desktop workspace where your own Claude Code, Codex, or DeepSeek key writes crypto trading strategies, backtests them, and runs them live on supported exchanges.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you describe a trading idea in plain language and have an AI agent turn it into a strategy. Each strategy keeps its backtests, trade history, parameter scans, and saved versions in one place. Backtests include overfitting checks: MCPT p-value, parameter plateau, and walk-forward analysis. Fees default to realistic values, and a fee of 0 triggers a warning. Auto-trading is wired for Binance, OKX, Bybit, BingX, Gate.io, Bitget, and StockCoin, plus Taiwan index futures on Windows. Paper trading works without API keys. The agent can also pull trading ideas from a few websites and return three to backtest. Every order is checked with the exchange and logged to state/audit.jsonl.
use_cases: Backtest a moving-average crossover on crypto
Write trading strategies with an AI coding agent
Paper trade crypto strategies without exchange keys
Auto-trade strategies on Binance, OKX, or Bybit
Scan strategy parameters and compare saved versions
Run Taiwan index futures strategies on Windows
how_to_run: Download the macOS or Windows build from the project and open it
Pick your AI provider (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek key, or Blave AI)
Describe a strategy idea in the app and let the agent backtest it
Build from source: git clone the repo, then cd blave-agent/shell
Run npm install, then npm start (Node.js 22.12+ and Python 3 required)
On Windows, use npm.cmd install and npm.cmd start in PowerShell
notable: Overfitting checks built into backtests: MCPT p-value, parameter plateau, walk-forward
Auto-trading wired for several crypto exchanges plus Taiwan index futures on Windows
Bring your own AI: Claude Code, Codex, or a DeepSeek key
Every order is verified with the exchange and written to an audit log
Paper trading mode needs no keys
caveats: The Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows shows a warning on first run
Cloud hosting for running strategies with the computer off is a paid plan
Trading can lose all your money; backtests describe only the past
keywords: test trading idea before risking money
